layouts.reader_task: Inspect one primary exhibit and its decision evidence without changing context.
layouts.tradeoff: Maximises legibility but permits only one analytical question.
layouts.avoid: Unrelated exhibits or a second conclusion competing with the headline.
layouts.split: Split after the exhibit when evidence exceeds six groups.
layouts.whitespace: Keep a visible gap between exhibit, evidence band, and source safe zone.

layouts.reader_task: Read a dominant quantitative exhibit while checking interpretation and counter-evidence.
layouts.reading_path: claim → chart → sidebar argument → evidence band
layouts.tradeoff: Adds interpretation beside the chart at the cost of plot width.
layouts.avoid: Long sidebar prose or labels that collapse the chart plot.
layouts.split: Move evidence details to a following full-evidence page when the sidebar exceeds three points.
layouts.whitespace: Preserve a 10mm gutter and an open lower edge above the evidence band.

layouts.reader_task: Understand a numeric bridge and audit the exact values in the same view.
layouts.reading_path: claim → chart → verification table → reconciliation note
layouts.tradeoff: Supports auditability but reduces both chart and table width.
layouts.avoid: Different measures, periods, or sorting between chart and table.
layouts.split: Continue the table only when exact-value rows exceed seven.
layouts.whitespace: Use a 9mm gutter and keep the reconciliation note attached to the table.

layouts.reader_task: Compare alternatives on identical criteria and identify the preferred option.
layouts.reading_path: claim → criteria by column → highlighted choice → implications
layouts.ratio: label column plus 3 equal option columns
layouts.tradeoff: Makes alternatives comparable but compresses explanatory prose.
layouts.avoid: Unequal criteria, hidden scoring logic, or color-only preference cues.
layouts.split: Create a second comparison page when alternatives exceed four.
layouts.whitespace: Use cell padding as the primary rhythm and leave space before implications.

layouts.reader_task: Compare repeated measures or evidence groups using a shared visual grammar.
layouts.reading_path: claim → panels left-to-right → shared legend → implication
layouts.tradeoff: Reveals patterns across panels but limits detail inside each panel.
layouts.avoid: Changing scales, encodings, or category order between panels.
layouts.split: Use two rows only up to six panels; otherwise start a new page.
layouts.whitespace: Equal gutters and aligned titles must separate panels without boxes.

layouts.reader_task: Locate scenarios by two decision variables and identify thresholds.
layouts.reading_path: claim → row and column axes → cells → threshold note
layouts.ratio: row header plus square data matrix
layouts.tradeoff: Shows interactions compactly but discourages precise trend reading.
layouts.avoid: Unlabelled axes, color-only values, or more than four levels per axis.
layouts.split: Separate matrices when either axis exceeds four levels.
layouts.whitespace: Reserve space for axis labels, legend, and the source-safe lower edge.

layouts.reader_task: Follow sequenced actions, owners, and explicit decision gates.
layouts.reading_path: claim → stages top-to-bottom → gate per stage → release condition
layouts.tradeoff: Makes governance explicit but leaves little room for task inventories.
layouts.avoid: Milestones without stop conditions or mixed time scales.
layouts.split: Continue on a new page after five stages and repeat the time context.
layouts.whitespace: Separate stages with rules and retain clear air around each gate.

layouts.reader_task: Read primary qualitative evidence and see how it changes the decision.
layouts.reading_path: claim → quotation or prose → analytical aside → takeaway
layouts.tradeoff: Preserves narrative voice but supports only one evidence item.
layouts.avoid: Decorative quotations, unattributed voices, or an aside longer than the evidence.
layouts.split: Use one quote per page; move corroboration to a following evidence page.
layouts.whitespace: Keep an 11mm gutter and let the quotation breathe without a container.

layouts.reader_task: Audit a long register across pages without losing column or status meaning.
layouts.reading_path: claim → continuation label → repeated header → rows → page implication
layouts.tradeoff: Preserves exact detail but requires a deliberate page break.
layouts.avoid: Orphan rows, changed column widths, missing repeated headers, or color-only status.
layouts.split: Break at a semantic row boundary and mark both first and continued segments.
layouts.whitespace: Keep the continuation label attached to the table and protect the source zone.

layouts.reader_task: Absorb the governing recommendation, then scan supporting metrics or decisions.
layouts.reading_path: claim → thesis → decision list → metric rail → evidence chain
layouts.tradeoff: Gives executives a fast overview but cannot carry full evidence detail.
layouts.avoid: More than one thesis, unexplained metrics, or dense citations inside the rail.
layouts.split: Move supporting analysis to dedicated pages once either rail exceeds four items.
layouts.whitespace: Use a 12mm gutter and preserve separation between overview and evidence chain.
